# Built-in workflow profiles (workflow v1.1.0)

An agent's `ProcessingSpec` overrides `max_iterations`, `run_timeout_seconds` and `safety_checks`; environment variables can override the LLM judge and fallback providers (see README.md).

| Profile | Max answer attempts | Run budget (s) | Provider timeout (s) | Provider retries | Data source retries | LLM judge | Safety checks | Fallback providers |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `default` | 3 | 60 | 30 | 3 | 2 | on | on | from env |
| `zoe` | 2 | 30 | 30 | 3 | 2 | on | on | from env |
